name: TraceAR
summary:
Bring your next drawing into your space with TraceAR.

Choose a reference from the built-in library or import a PNG or JPG from your headset. Place it over your paper, canvas or wall, adjust its size and opacity, then lock it in place while you draw with your own materials.

MAKE IT FIT
Move and rotate references, resize from the corners or stretch individual edges. Use flat, cylinder, sphere and corner surface modes to shape your reference. Work with multiple images and switch between centimetres and inche
